rejectedFindings.title: Post-activity inference comment overstates the available correlation

confidence.rationale: The first review traced an ambiguous message ordering and the missing turn_id contract.

rejectedFindings.symptom: The comment claimed later standalone messages could not be attached to a completed turn.
rejectedFindings.consequence: A future maintainer could mistake a heuristic for a guaranteed correlation rule.
rejectedFindings.remedy: Closed: the comment now names the assumption and the data-model ambiguity.
rejectedFindings.verification: Cross-family re-review confirmed the corrected wording matches the implementation.

rejectedFindings.title: Outside-click dismissal lacked browser coverage

confidence.rationale: The first review verified the pointerdown path was absent from the test.

rejectedFindings.symptom: The settings panel's new outside-click handler had no regression assertion.
rejectedFindings.consequence: A broken pointerdown handler could leave the panel open without failing the suite.
rejectedFindings.remedy: Closed: the test now clicks a neutral rail heading and verifies dismissal without focus restoration.
rejectedFindings.verification: Focused Chromium test passed and the cross-family re-review confirmed the assertion distinguishes the path.

rejectedFindings.title: Keyboard rail collapse could preserve an open settings state

confidence.rationale: The first review traced Enter activation, which emits no pointerdown dismissal.

rejectedFindings.symptom: Collapsing with Enter could unmount the open dialog without clearing settingsOpen.
rejectedFindings.consequence: Re-expanding the rail could reopen stale settings state.
rejectedFindings.remedy: Closed: a collapsed-state effect closes settings, with an Enter-key browser assertion through re-expansion.
rejectedFindings.verification: Focused Chromium test passed and the cross-family re-review confirmed the test distinguishes state reset from unmounting.
